Yiddish Sentences
	


  
Audio dataset, split-out. Rows copied from the master, danielrosehill/Read-Aloud-Voice-Sentences, so one task can be browsed alone. Training reads the master, not this copy. Every audio dataset as one tree, with hours: the audio index. How every dataset fits together: the dataset index.


English sentences with Yiddish words written in Latin letters (shul, daven, cholent, mensch, freier, tachles), the way English speakers in Israel use them, read aloud by… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Hebrish/Yiddish-Sentences.
